_readme: Judgment overrides applied AFTER the stat model. Keep this list tiny and always give a reason. delta is added to the generated value (clamped to 25-99; overall clamped to 45-99).

overrides.name: Draymond Green
overrides.reason: Box score badly undersells his defense and playmaking (3 pts/g, but he anchors the defense and runs the offense). Judgment call, not stat-derived.

overrides.name: Matisse Thybulle
overrides.reason: Elite 3&D wing whose value is mostly low-usage defense the box score undersells (2.9 stl/36 already, but EFF rates him like a bench scrub). Judgment call.
